knownIssues.description: Auto diff through sign, floor, ceil, round and the max/min reductions throws NullPointerException (and for round, forward mode succeeds while reverse mode throws).
knownIssues.intendedBehaviour: sign/floor/ceil/round have a zero derivative almost everywhere; max/min reductions pass the gradient to the selected element(s).

knownIssues.description: The binary max/min vertices reject broadcasting shapes at construction, although the tensor operations (tensors.json binary/max and binary/min) broadcast them.
